_readme: THE FIXED LIST OF TASK KINDS a split test may measure (CQ-8 (minimum bench test 1) part 6, seeded 2026-10-10 from the developer's card). New kinds are added by the developer or the bench owner, never by a run: new-workflow-design/builds/chain-qa/split_test.py refuses a test card whose task_kind is not on this list, by name, before any spend. Findings in each split-test run record carry one of these words, so evidence about a model can be gathered by task kind across runs.
